page: Microsoft Azure D48ds_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine built on the x86_64 architecture and powered by Microsoft Hyper-V. The system is provisioned with 48 dedicated vCPUs derived from 24 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8573C processor running at clock speeds up to 4.2 GHz. The hardware architecture incorporates 48 KB of L1 data cache per core, 2 MB of L2 cache per core, and a shared 260 MB L3 cache. It also features hardware vector extensions including AVX-512, AMX (tile and int8), and cryptographic acceleration instructions such as VAES and SHA-NI.

Memory capacity is configured at 192 GB of RAM, maintaining a balanced 4 GB per vCPU ratio typical of general-purpose instances. In memory benchmarking, the server demonstrates strong large-block memory bandwidth, recording 232.42 GB/sec in read operations and 100.8 GB/sec in write operations. Unlike diskless configurations, the D48ds_v6 bundles 2,835 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage, providing high-capacity, low-latency temporary scratch space directly adjacent to the compute cores.

Benchmark results place the D48ds_v6 in the upper quartile across various computational, compilation, and storage tasks. Geekbench scoring yields 2,140 in single-core and 19,924 in multi-core metrics, alongside strong software compilation performance using Clang. PassMark evaluations reflect high computational and cryptographic throughput, scoring 62,410.33 overall CPU score and 49,282.67 on encryption tests. In application benchmarks, the instance delivers 67.91 million operations per second on Redis SET tasks, 80.58 GB/sec throughput on static web serving, and top-tier execution in small-model LLM generation.

From an architectural standpoint, the D48ds_v6 balances substantial processing power and rapid NVMe scratch storage without the added operational cost or overhead of discrete GPUs. The configuration makes it a suitable candidate for large relational and non-relational database nodes, caching layers, continuous integration software build pipelines, and high-concurrency web serving environments.
description: Microsoft Azure D48ds_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine equipped with 48 dedicated vCPUs running on a 24-core Intel Xeon 8573C processor clocked at up to 4.2 GHz. Built on x86_64 architecture with 260 MB of L3 cache, the system includes 192 GB of RAM and 2,835 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD storage. It features advanced instruction sets including AMX and AVX-512. Benchmarking demonstrates strong performance across multiple tiers, generating 19,924 points in Geekbench multi-core testing, 67.91 million Redis SET operations per second, and 80.58 GB/sec static web serving throughput. Large-block memory throughput reaches 232.42 GB/sec read and 100.8 GB/sec write. By combining substantial memory bandwidth, high core density, and high-speed local disk capacity without the cost profile of GPU acceleration, the D48ds_v6 is engineered for heavy enterprise database operations, build pipelines, caching clusters, and high-concurrency web applications.
